ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course section is open for registration to undergrad degree-seeking students, any major. On-campus students who register in this section will be charged an additional fee of $933 above their normal tuition range assessment. This course is offered through the Office of Continuing Education as an online course section which cannot be included in the normal range assessment. Financial aid and certain waivers may cover this additional tuition assessment along with your regular range assessments. Please note that there is an on-campus section of PLPA 200 that may be taken as part of your normal range tuition assessment.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $298.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $270.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
